description: This file defines the class RomCellRenderer, which is a custom Swing TreeCellRenderer used for rendering nodes in a JTree, specifically for displaying ROM and table data in the RomRaider application. It customizes icons, labels, and appearance based on the node type and state.

classes.name: RomCellRenderer
classes.description: A custom tree cell renderer for displaying ROM and table nodes in a JTree with customized icons, labels, and background colors.

methods.name: RomCellRenderer()
methods.description: Constructor initializing label components for rendering tree nodes.

methods.name: getTreeCellRendererComponent
methods.description: Overrides method to customize the rendering of tree nodes, including handling Rom objects and TableTreeNode objects, setting labels, icons, background, and border styles.
